plugins.name: ranko
plugins.description: Your session's figures above the Claude Code prompt: how full the context is and how far off auto-compaction is, the prompt cache, your plan's limits and when they run full, the task list, and a Compact button. Beside them Ranko, the rankello® mascot, shows what Claude is doing: he types, thinks, waves when it waits for you, cheers and naps.
